domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD, LCM, or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag in pure-fraction or mixed-number items when unlike fractional denominators are reconciled.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that use the existing denominator.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form with standard whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction such as 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is converted to a standard mixed number such as 2 3/2 becoming 3 1/2.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align the structure of the quantities before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only for denominator matching.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction occurs after normalization or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust an insufficient or negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-formatting-only steps.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units of the current denominator when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to complete the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as denominator over denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag in whole-minus-fraction, mixed-minus-fraction, or mixed-number subtraction when regrouping resolves a negative or insufficient fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus zero fraction before any need to borrow.
Do not tag simplification after the regrouped subtraction is completed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including recognizing when the result simplifies to a whole number or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag unsimplified subtraction steps.
Do not tag merely writing the final answer if no reduction or whole-number simplification occurs.
Do not tag common-denominator conversions before subtraction.
